### 1 — Scene
A light fruit-and-salad plate: pineapple, strawberries and blueberries beside leafy greens with cucumber and shredded carrot.

### 2 — Vessel
A shallow, wide-rimmed plate/bowl, approximately **26 cm across**.  
Vessel area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible foods are pineapple, strawberries, blueberries, leafy greens, cucumber and carrot. The salad has a slight sheen, so I include a small, uncertain allowance for oil-based dressing.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
The foods cover approximately **44% of the vessel’s total area**, excluding the exposed rim. Dressing overlaps the salad rather than covering additional area.

| Item | Area share | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Leafy greens | 19% | 101 cm² × 2 cm = 202 ml | 0.15 | 30 g | 20 | 6 |
| Pineapple | 7% | 37 cm² × 2 cm = 74 ml | 0.65 | 48 g | 50 | 24 |

| Blueberries | 3% | 16 cm² × 1.2 cm = 19 ml | 0.65 | 12 g | 57 | 7 |

| Shredded carrot | 2% | 11 cm² × 0.6 cm = 6.6 ml | 0.50 | 3 g | 41 | 1 |
| Dressing, estimated oil content | Overlapping | Approximately 3 ml | ~1.0 | 3 g | 884 | 27 |
| **Total** | **44%** | | | **190 g** | | **93** |

### 8 — Sanity check
Approximately **190 g and 93 kcal** is plausible for this modest portion of fruit and loose salad. Dressing is the main energy uncertainty; without the estimated oil, it would be about **66 kcal**.
